dlc.title: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned

roadmap.title: The Fadefields
roadmap.description: Play the first region's story to Rush the Gate, shoot the Tannis cutout barrels, and uncover the map. Complete the Airship event if it appears and kill a world boss.

roadmap.title: Carcadia Burn
roadmap.description: Finish the Ripper Queen story and the Electi questline. In Vend up the Line, sell three green items before buying the legendary, then give Zane the photo; do not buy first.

roadmap.title: Terminus Range
roadmap.description: Finish the Terminus story and Auger questline. In Exit Through the Rift Shop, punch Oddman into the rift instead of shooting him.

roadmap.title: Dominion and the finale
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining main missions, uncover Dominion, and complete the Claptrap missions.

roadmap.title: Endgame cleanup
roadmap.description: After the story: UVH ranks, Primordial Vaults, activities, contracts, side missions, challenges, Dave Burrito, levels 30 and 50, vehicles, and legendary gear.

roadmap.title: DLC packs
roadmap.description: Optional paid packs, in release order: Stone Demon, Mad Ellie, A Zane to Kill For, Murders and Acquisitions, Amara, FL4K.

achievements.description: Reach player level 10.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 10.

steps.text: Play the story and side content until you reach level 10.

achievements.description: Reach player level 30.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 30.

guide.context: After the story, a new Ultimate Vault Hunter character starts at level 30, which unlocks this at once.

steps.text: Keep leveling through the story and side missions until you reach level 30.

achievements.description: Reach player level 50.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 50.

guide.context: Replaying Primordial Vaults gives about one level every 20-30 minutes from level 30.

steps.text: Reach level 50 by finishing the story and side missions.
If you are short, run contracts, Ultimate Vault Hunter challenges, or Primordial Vaults.

achievements.description: Reach Ultimate Vault Hunter level 5.
achievements.summary: Reach Ultimate Vault Hunter level 5.

guide.context: This is the only achievement that needs a higher difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the story through Main Mission 25 to unlock @mechanic{Ultimate Vault Hunter} mode.
Rank 1: finish Zane's Firmware, Maurice's Bounty, Big Encore, and the Wildcard Missions.

Rank 2: defeat @enemy{Bio-Bulkhead} in Synthetic Nave, @enemy{Bramblesong} in the Abandoned Auger Mine in Stoneblood Forest, @enemy{Bio Armored Omega Thresher} as the final fight of the side mission One Slime Issue, and @enemy{Sydney Pointylegs} at the Ripper Drill Site in Hungering Plain. Then talk to @npc{Lilith} for the next story mission.

Rank 3: defeat @enemy{Core Observer} in the Order Bunker at The Howl, @enemy{Shadowpelt} in the Abandoned Auger Mine at Cuspid Climb, @enemy{Rocken Roller} in the Abandoned Auger Mine at Ruined Sumplands, and @enemy{Frank the Furnace} at the Ripper Drill Site in Idolator's Noose. Then talk to Lilith again.

Rank 4: defeat @enemy{Mimicron} in the Order Bunker at Idolator's Noose, @enemy{the Immortal Boneface} at the Ripper Drill Site in Cuspid Climb, @enemy{Battle Wagon} at the Ripper Drill Site in Stoneblood Forest, and @enemy{Skull Orchid} in the Abandoned Auger Mine at Grindstone of the Worthy. Then talk to Lilith again.
Rank 5: finish the three Primordial Vault Wildcard missions for Fadefields, Terminus Range, and Carcadia Burn.

achievements.description: Collect 60 cosmetics.
achievements.summary: Collect 60 cosmetics.

steps.text: Do missions and challenges, and open the reward boxes in the Equipment menu until you own 60 cosmetics.

achievements.description: Collect 10 personal vehicles.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 personal vehicles.

guide.context: Unlocked vehicles are saved on your profile, so every character shares them. The free "How Rush Saved Mercenary Day" mission gives an extra vehicle from inventory rewards, and it counts toward the 10.

steps.text: Finish Main Missions 3, 6, 10, 14, 16, and 20 to earn six vehicles.
Reach level 50 with each of the four characters to earn the other four from their character challenges.
After the story, start the other characters through New Game - Ultimate Vault Hunter at level 30 and level them to 50.

achievements.description: Equip legendary gear in every slot.
achievements.summary: Have a legendary item equipped in every gear slot.

guide.context: Endgame sources include Ultimate Vault Hunter 5 loot, item-of-the-day vending machines, weekly Wildcard missions, Maurice's Bounty, and Primordial Vaults.

steps.text: Equip a legendary in all nine slots: four weapons, @item{Repkit}, grenade, class mod, shield, and enhancement.
Keep every legendary you find in the bank until you have one for each slot.

achievements.description: Complete any Gear Challenge category.
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge in one gear category.

guide.context: Assault Rifles are the easiest. Enemies spawned by @enemy{Core Observer} die in one hit and give kill progress quickly.

steps.text: Open the Challenges menu and pick one gear category, such as Assault Rifle.
Finish every challenge in that category.

achievements.description: Complete any Manufacturer Challenge category.
achievements.summary: Complete every challenge for one manufacturer.

guide.context: Eight manufacturers count: Order, Ripper, Torgue, Tediore, Maliwan, Vladof, Daedalus, and Jakobs. Jakobs is the easiest.

steps.text: Open the Challenges menu and pick one manufacturer, such as Jakobs.
Finish every challenge in that manufacturer's category.

achievements.description: Complete all activities.
achievements.summary: Complete all 53 activities.

guide.context: Finish this after the story. Fight activities scale to about level 40 then.

steps.text: Open the Activities list in the Challenges menu.
Clear every Silo, Safehouse, Crawler, Auger Mine, Bunker, and Drill Site on it.

achievements.description: Complete the Goredello world event.
achievements.summary: Complete the Goredello world event.

guide.context: World events are random. They show at medium map zoom and vanish fast, so check the map often.

steps.text: Look for the Goredello icon in @loc{Cuspid Climb}, @loc{Terminus Range}.
Play through all 3 rounds. The reward level does not matter.

achievements.description: Complete the Airship world event.
achievements.summary: Complete the Airship world event.

guide.context: World events are random. They show at medium map zoom and vanish fast, so check the map often.

steps.text: Look for the Airship icon at @loc{The Flarewell}, @loc{Hungering Plain}, @loc{The Fadefields}.
Destroy items and enemies on all 4 airships.

achievements.description: Complete the Creep Impact world event.
achievements.summary: Complete the Creep Impact world event.

guide.context: World events are random. They show at medium map zoom and vanish fast, so check the map often.

steps.text: Look for the Creep Impact icon at @loc{Stardown Point}, @loc{Lopside}, @loc{Carcadia Burn}.
Play the event through to its end.

achievements.description: Complete 80 contracts.
achievements.summary: Complete 80 contracts.

guide.context: Purple contracts appear after the story and give extra XP.

steps.text: Take contracts from a Contract Board in a safehouse. You can hold 5 at a time.
Prefer collect and patrol contracts; skip hunter ones.
Reload from the main menu to refresh the boards until you reach 80.

achievements.description: Discover all map locations in The Fadefields.
achievements.summary: Discover every map location in The Fadefields.

steps.text: Explore until every "?" icon in @loc{The Fadefields} is uncovered. You do not need to complete them.

achievements.description: Discover all map locations in Terminus Range.
achievements.summary: Discover every map location in Terminus Range.

steps.text: Explore until every "?" icon in @loc{Terminus Range} is uncovered. You do not need to complete them.

achievements.description: Discover all map locations in Carcadia Burn.
achievements.summary: Discover every map location in Carcadia Burn.

steps.text: Explore until every "?" icon in @loc{Carcadia Burn} is uncovered. You do not need to complete them.

achievements.description: Discover all map locations in Dominion City.
achievements.summary: Discover every map location in Dominion City.

guide.context: Dominion City opens at Main Mission 17.

steps.text: Explore until every "?" icon in @loc{Dominion City} is uncovered. You do not need to complete them.

achievements.description: Defeat a World boss.
achievements.summary: Defeat a world boss.

guide.context: In co-op, no player may bleed out.

steps.text: Enter a white bubble dome on the map and defeat the boss inside.
Stay inside the bubble. Leaving or dying ends the fight.

achievements.description: Defeat all Guardians in Primordial Vaults.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Guardian in each of the three Primordial Vaults.

guide.context: The final vault is not needed. Easy difficulty is fine.

steps.text: Collect 3 Vault Fragments in each region, 9 in total.
Open the Primordial Vault in The Fadefields, Carcadia Burn, and Terminus Range.
Beat the 3 waves and the Guardian in each vault.

achievements.description: Complete all Outbounder missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all Outbounder faction missions.

steps.text: Start with the mission @item{Null and Void} in The Fadefields.
Continue through All Charged Up and Bound for Launch.
Do the last Outbounder missions after the main story.

achievements.description: Complete all Auger missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all Auger faction missions.

steps.text: Start with Mob Mentality in Terminus Range.
Continue through Mob Rules, Angry Mob, and Mob Justice.

achievements.description: Complete all Electi missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all five Electi missions.

steps.text: Complete in Carcadia Burn: Enter the Electi Part I, Enter the Electi Part II, The Council Divided, A Traitor Within, and The Mole's Gambit.

achievements.description: Complete all Claptrap missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all Claptrap missions.

guide.context: This may also unlock after the first Claptrap mission in The Fadefields, which is a known bug. Completing all side missions unlocks it as well.

steps.text: Finish all five Claptrap missions. Their names are Father of the Glide, Peak Performance, Potty Mouth, Sum of His Parts, and No Place Like Home.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all side missions.

guide.context: The counter shows 98 even though some missions count twice. Use a single save, because progress may not carry to a new character.

steps.text: Check Missions > Challenges > World for the counter, and Missions > Replay for what you have done.

Find the unmarked missions. Mort sits on a rock and gives Breeding Daisies, then Whack-a-Thresher a little east. For Forgive Me, kill the badass in the cave below to get the quest, then find Zanzibart's resting place. Open the red chest for The Neverending Quarry, use the vending machine for A Quarry of Epic Proportions, and use the dumpster for The Final Quarrel. Each of the last three starts an ambush.
Finish every side mission marked with a blue "!" on the map.

achievements.description: Complete the mission Rush the Gate.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission Rush the Gate.

steps.text: Finish Main Mission 6, @item{Rush the Gate}, the end of The Fadefields.

achievements.displayName: As If Moved by an Occult Hand
achievements.description: Complete the mission His Vile Sanctum.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission His Vile Sanctum.

steps.text: Finish Main Mission 14, @item{His Vile Sanctum}, the end of Terminus Range.

achievements.description: Complete the mission Her Flaming Vision.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission Her Flaming Vision.

steps.text: Finish Main Mission 10, @item{Her Flaming Vision}, the end of Carcadia Burn, by defeating the Ripper Queen.

achievements.description: Finish the rescue story mission called Another Day, Another Universe.
achievements.summary: Finish the rescue story mission called Another Day, Another Universe.

steps.text: Play the sixteenth main mission, @item{Another Day, Another Universe}, to its end.

achievements.description: Complete the mission The Timekeeper's Order.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission The Timekeeper's Order.

steps.text: Finish Main Mission 20, @item{The Timekeeper's Order}, the end of Dominion.

achievements.description: Tip Moxxi.
achievements.summary: Tip Moxxi.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Moxxi's Bottoms Up} in @loc{Ruined Sumplands}, Carcadia Burn.
Tip @npc{Moxxi} $100 or $1,000.

achievements.description: Locate the Tannis cutout.
achievements.summary: Locate the cardboard cutout of Dr. Patricia Tannis.

steps.text: Go to @loc{The Howl} in The Fadefields, near Coastal Bonescape.
Shoot the barrels by color in sequence: green, light blue, red, blue, then yellow.
Watch the cutout appear from the ocean.

achievements.description: Give Zane the photo dropped by the machine.
achievements.summary: Give Zane the photo dropped by the Legendary Vending Machine.

guide.context: @warn{Missable.} The mission cannot be replayed from the menu. If you miss it, start a new Ultimate Vault Hunter character at level 30 or join a co-op player at that point.

steps.text: In the mission @item{Vend up the Line}, defeat the Legendary Vending Machine.
Sell it 3 green items first. Do not buy anything before this.
Buy 1 legendary from the machine.
Pick up the Picture of Zane and Levaine, and give it to @npc{Zane} at @loc{Moxxi's Bottoms Up}.

achievements.description: Find Francis Oddman's final resting place.
achievements.summary: Find Francis Oddman's final resting place.

guide.context: @warn{Missable.} Shooting Oddman loses the achievement. If you miss it, start a new Ultimate Vault Hunter character at level 30 or join a co-op player at that point.

steps.text: Take the mission @item{Exit Through the Rift Shop}.
Punch @npc{Francis Oddman} into the rift. Do not shoot him.
Go to his frozen body in @loc{Windspear}, Terminus Range.

achievements.description: Find Dave the Burrito.
achievements.summary: Find Dave the Burrito.

guide.context: Burritos are unmarked, so you must get close and shoot each one. None are missable. Districts open at Main Missions 17 (Carcadia), 18 (Fades), and 20 (Upper Dominion). After all 15, the door to Dave opens in Upper Dominion. Glide through the small waterfall near the north Vault Symbol, and walk near the golden burrito.

collectibles.name: Burrito 1
collectibles.location: Behind a bench next to an @item{ECHO Log}, in the north of the district
collectibles.method: Climb the wall at the northern edge to enter the building, then follow the corridor.

collectibles.name: Burrito 2
collectibles.location: On the front roof of Mosmellow Retreat
collectibles.method: Jump onto the roof and look at the metal piece hanging off the wall.

collectibles.name: Burrito 3
collectibles.location: In a Kratch nest in the yellow acid water area
collectibles.method: Climb to the top of the nest, inside a green hive.

collectibles.name: Burrito 4
collectibles.location: Small balcony on the house in the yellow acid water
collectibles.method: Go to the north-east corner, near the bottom of the house.

collectibles.name: Burrito 5
collectibles.location: Behind a stall with a green light
collectibles.method: Stand between a @item{Propaganda Speaker} and an @item{ECHO Log}, upstairs, and walk around the left side of that stall.

collectibles.name: Burrito 6
collectibles.location: Whimsy Willies food counter near the Food Court safehouse
collectibles.method: Climb the yellow ledge above the fast travel station and check the right counter.

collectibles.name: Burrito 7
collectibles.location: Toilet in the blue-lit room with mattresses
collectibles.method: It is in the corner, inside the large building near the Keep Out exit.

collectibles.name: Burrito 8
collectibles.method: Check the washing machines behind the counter, east of the checkpoint.

collectibles.name: Burrito 9
collectibles.location: Top shelf of a food shop east of Frantic Scrawl
collectibles.method: Take the stairs east into the tunnel, first left, then next right.

collectibles.name: Burrito 10
collectibles.method: Look under the west-most pumpkin shelf, next to the biggest pumpkin.

collectibles.name: Burrito 11
collectibles.location: Behind the stairs near Zadra's Lab
collectibles.method: It is on a green box under a collectible.

collectibles.name: Burrito 12
collectibles.location: Corpse at a Ripper camp entrance
collectibles.method: It is in the upward-facing hand of the hanging body.

collectibles.name: Burrito 13
collectibles.location: Storage shack beside an @item{ECHO Log}, north of the swamp
collectibles.method: Walk the wooden boardwalks along the edge.

collectibles.name: Burrito 14
collectibles.location: Raised flower bed with a tree, next to an @item{ECHO Log}
collectibles.method: It is hidden under the foliage.

collectibles.name: Burrito 15
collectibles.method: Look behind the boombox, on the pallet.

achievements.displayName: Ordon't You Glad I Didn't Say Eridium
achievements.description: Kill 50 Ordonite enemies.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 Ordonite enemies.

steps.text: Kill 50 enemies carrying yellow Ordonite shards, in The Demon's Domain.
Bosses with a boss machine have them. Farming one repeatedly is quick.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in The Demon's Domain.
achievements.summary: Defeat all four bosses in The Demon's Domain.

steps.text: Defeat the 3 bosses along the story path and the last boss at the end of the story.

achievements.description: Complete the mission The Cursed Mine.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission The Cursed Mine.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{The Cursed Mine}.

achievements.description: Complete all activities on the Whispering Glacier.
achievements.summary: Complete all three activities on the Whispering Glacier.

guide.context: Uncovering the "?" icons on the map shows them.

steps.text: Gurgling Stent: survive the Fuel Siphon onslaught.
Crisis Scar Weeping: kill the DAHL Bunker boss.
Thrombosis Purge: survive the Fuel Siphon onslaught.

achievements.displayName: Looking for Work at the Top of the World
achievements.description: Complete all side missions on the Whispering Glacier.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 side missions on the Whispering Glacier.

guide.context: The missions appear during Main Mission 3 of the pack.

steps.text: Finish these 11: Host in the Shell, Yes Chef, Doc of the Bay, Symbiotic Security Parts 1 and 2, Ice Fishing, A Humble Abode, Voices Carry, Summoner's Gift, Star-Crossed, and Ghost Stories.

One of these 11 is hidden. To unlock it, go to the first fast travel station in the upper-left of the map and take dynamite from the buckets by the water and throw it at the bubbles. If no bubbles show, reload or walk to the next dynamite. Grapple the ECHO recording that appears, 4 times, then take the quest at the bar.

achievements.description: Defeat a Rift boss.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Rift boss on the Whispering Glacier.

guide.context: The rift spawns at random, so check the map now and then. The boss may be marked on it.

steps.text: Find the glowing orange-red rift that spawns at a random place on the Whispering Glacier.
Interact with the rift and defeat the boss in its arena.

achievements.description: Complete the mission On Icebound Shores Abandoned.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission On Icebound Shores Abandoned.

steps.text: Finish the pack's story mission number 1, @item{On Icebound Shores Abandoned}.

achievements.description: Complete the mission Hearing Things.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission Hearing Things.

steps.text: Finish the pack's story mission number 2, @item{Hearing Things}.

achievements.description: Complete the mission It Grows Below.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission It Grows Below.

steps.text: Finish the pack's story mission number 3, @item{It Grows Below}.

achievements.description: Complete the mission What Lies Dreaming.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission What Lies Dreaming.

steps.text: Finish the pack's story mission number 4, @item{What Lies Dreaming}.

achievements.description: Complete the mission Damnation Encroaches.
achievements.summary: Complete the mission Damnation Encroaches.

steps.text: Finish Main Mission 5, @item{Damnation Encroaches}, the final mission of the pack.

achievements.description: Use tokens to open a chest.
achievements.summary: Use tokens to open a chest.

steps.text: Collect the tokens that appear on the map during the pack. About 3 open one chest.
Beat the final boss, then open a chest with tokens.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in Private Dick.
achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses in Private Dick.

steps.text: Defeat the 2 other bosses and the final boss.

achievements.description: Complete the main story mission of the A Zane to Kill For pack.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story mission of the A Zane to Kill For pack.

steps.text: Finish the pack's main story mission.

achievements.description: Choose every option in the Murders and Acquisitions mission.
achievements.summary: Choose every option in the Murders and Acquisitions story mission.

steps.text: Write down each of the 3 choices you make in the pack's story mission.
Replay the pack with the same character and choose the other option each time.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in The Toxic Scowl.
achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses in The Toxic Scowl.

steps.text: Go without a companion.
Steal the item when given the choice.
Accept the duel if it is offered.
Defeat every boss you reach, including the final boss.

achievements.description: Complete the main story mission of Murders and Acquisitions.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story mission of Murders and Acquisitions.

steps.text: Finish the pack's main story mission.

achievements.description: Open the locked treasure room in Nuada Cove.
achievements.summary: Open the locked treasure room in Nuada Cove.

steps.text: Find the room in the middle of the map, with 4 lamps on its right. They must all turn blue to drop the barrier.
Shoot the first target in the sewer where the small Thrashers first appear.
Shoot the second target at the flying machine.
Shoot the third target as you slide down after jumping.
Shoot the fourth target beside the barrier.

achievements.description: Defeat all bosses in Nuada Cove and Dark Side of Elpis.
achievements.summary: Defeat all bosses in Nuada Cove and Dark Side of Elpis.

steps.text: Defeat the final boss and the Thrasher.
After the story, defeat the bosses in the extra arena that opens.

achievements.description: Complete the main story mission of Amara and the Vile Shadows.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story mission of Amara and the Vile Shadows.

steps.text: Finish the pack's main story mission.

achievements.description: Complete all Tiki Bar, Tediore Lockdown, and Occupied Sector activities on Providence Island.
achievements.summary: Complete all Tiki Bar, Tediore Lockdown, and Occupied Sector activities on Providence Island.

steps.text: Clear every Tiki Bar, Tediore Lockdown, and Occupied Sector activity on @loc{Providence Island}.

achievements.description: Complete all side missions on Providence Island.
achievements.summary: Complete all side missions on Providence Island.

steps.text: Finish every side mission on @loc{Providence Island}.

achievements.description: Defeat a boss from a digi-rift.
achievements.summary: Defeat a boss from a digi-rift.

steps.text: Find the digi-rift that spawns at a random place, step in, and defeat the boss.

achievements.description: Take the treasure at the end of the substation switch series.
achievements.summary: Take the treasure at the end of the substation switch series.

steps.text: Finish the series of switches at the substation and take the treasure at the end.

achievements.description: Complete the FL4K and the Last Resort pack mission involving a skag and a robot.
achievements.summary: Complete the FL4K and the Last Resort pack mission involving a skag and a robot.

steps.text: Finish the FL4K and the Last Resort mission involving a skag and a robot.

achievements.description: Complete a pack mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the pack mission about the interference-free connection.

steps.text: Finish the pack's mission about the interference-free connection.

achievements.description: Open the door to Tediore stronghold Bravo Lima 4.2.
achievements.summary: Open the door to Tediore stronghold Bravo Lima 4.2.

steps.text: Open the door of the Tediore stronghold @loc{Bravo Lima 4.2}.

achievements.description: Complete a pack mission.
achievements.summary: Complete the rescue mission of the FL4K and the Last Resort pack.

steps.text: Finish the pack's rescue mission.
